source_judgments: R876 retains optional initial naming, required nonempty lists and optional intergroup commas. R877 uses explicit R903/C903 variable-name and an optional declarator, not a selected array element or structure component.

C8121 requires an explicit-shape-spec list rather than R818 vector bounds. C8122 counts the actual variable across all COMMON lists in one scope; permitted repeated block names and separately scoped views are distinct.
C8123 retains all ten exclusions and ultimate-component recursion. Enumeration type is not enum type, and type/block BIND is not BIND on a variable.
C8124 requires BIND or SEQUENCE on the type together with no default initialization. One direct or recursively direct component initializer, including a pointer initialized to NULL, suffices.

C8125 excludes a USE-associated member name, including a renamed one, but not access to a module's existing COMMON variable or an otherwise legal block-name homonym. A local COMMON member hides a host homonym under19.5.1.4p2(7).

Ordered list continuation and numeric/character sequence-component interpretation have finite complete-program plans with independent literal observations. Other derived/BIND layouts receive no inferred component sequence.

The local storage sequence includes all eligible equivalence extensions. Direct and transitive tail plans include three and four numeric units respectively; array order retains the original lower-bound-dependent Table9.1.
8.10.2.3 is definition-only: no S requirement, facet or empty execution. Size is the full language storage sequence, not a physical byte count or address difference.

8.10.2.4 preserves distinct nonzero/zero named/blank branches. Its three zero-payload facets are positive controls, not runtime association effects. Seven restrictions retain nonpointer groups, actual type identity, kind/length, pointer rank/parameter patterns and TARGET conditions.

Pointer storage units independently distinguish CONTIGUOUS; TARGET partners do not acquire p7's pointer rank-equality rule. Storage association does not perform numeric conversion or make every cross-type view defined.
RETURN/END retention is for nonpointer blank-common objects. Unsaved named-common undefinition is conditional under19.6.6; SAVE neither initializes values nor extends ended pointer targets.
Named-block size equality includes every declaring scope, even unexecuted procedures, and all equivalence extensions. Blank-block size variation retains identical storage-unit prefixes.

Named BLOCK DATA initialization permission preserves C808/C880, complete block specification, one BLOCK DATA declaration and at-most-once storage initialization. Blank initial definition is prohibited; explicit COMMON initialization does not invoke the non-COMMON implicit-SAVE rule.

8.10.3 prohibits direct or indirect joining of different blocks, association of default-initialized derived objects with COMMON, and extension before the first specified unit.8.10.2.2's tail-only source connection has the same S8.10.3-003 owner.

Complete future effects need defined sentinels, actual calls, literal checks and whole-parent sensitivity. An omitted writer must be caught before any potentially undefined payload read. These are pending plans, not implemented mutation evidence.

Numbered reporting capability, Clause19 name/scope duties and non-report-required prose restrictions remain distinct. Generic linker/layout/internal failures are not source-specific diagnostics; no universal fatal-exit or fixed-English policy is introduced.
